key_highlights: ASX slumps on oil-driven inflation fears and fourth RBA rate hike expectations; bond yields spike
Mortgage stress hits 18-year highs; house prices could fall 10% as rate cycle tightens further
Australia narrowly avoids recession but per-capita contraction and 'bad to worse' productivity signal structural weakness
Gold sector active: Gateway high-grade discovery near Wiluna, King River 44g/t jags, Auric $28M profit, PLC Murchison extension
Coal boom returns with WA government pushing merger of state's two remaining mines; Chinese solar overtakes coal globally
Property developer Bathla warns of potential collapse; 'Evergrande moment' narrative gains traction
Qantas ground crews vote for right to strike amid pay dispute
Mineral Resources ASIC investigation declared 'over' – positive for MRG.AX sentiment
CBA inactive-card fee saga highlights banking sector consumer trust erosion

sectors.trend: Gold exploration activity robust across WA and Qld (Gateway, King River, Moonlight, Auric, PLC). Coal sector sees structural shift as WA pushes mine merger and Chinese solar overtakes coal. Copper (True North) and lithium (ZhongNuo/Chariot) exploration continues.
sectors.implications: Gold miners and explorers (GWN.AX, KRV.AX, AUC.AX, PLC.AX) benefit from safe-haven flows amid rate-hike fears. Coal names (BHP.AX, WDS.AX) face long-term structural headwinds despite short-term price support. MRG.AX clears ASIC overhang.

sectors.trend: Mortgage stress at 18-year highs and potential 10% house-price correction pressure NIMs and credit-loss provisions. CBA fee controversy dents consumer trust. Fourth rate hike looms, compressing margins.
sectors.implications: Big Four (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX) face rising NPL risk from housing stress. Rate hikes support NIMs short-term but credit costs will follow. Defensive positioning warranted.

sectors.trend: Oil price spike fuels inflation and rate-hike fears. Coal booms domestically but Chinese solar capacity passing coal signals long-term demand shift. WA coal mine merger reduces supply flexibility.
sectors.implications: Short-term oil-driven inflation benefits energy producers (WDS.AX, SXG.AX) but triggers RBA tightening. Long-term energy transition headwinds for thermal coal. LNG (BHP.AX, WDS.AX) remains resilient.

sectors.trend: Qantas ground-crew strike vote threatens operational disruption. Housing affordability crisis and mortgage stress suppress consumer spending. Small-business sentiment deteriorating.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces industrial-action risk and potential revenue disruption. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WOW.AX) may see margin pressure. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) vulnerable to rate-driven occupancy risk.

sectors.trend: AI bubble concerns (Iran headline) and Citi's contrarian tech-buy call create volatility. Property developer implosions (Bathla, 'Evergrande moment') threaten construction-linked REITs and builders.
sectors.implications: ASX tech names (WTC.AX, SVL.AX) face sentiment risk. REITs and builders (WBC.AX exposure, CGP.AX) face credit and demand risk from housing correction. Canva (CVA – private) privacy dispute a minor governance flag.

key_themes: RBA fourth rate hike and inflation re-acceleration from oil
Housing market correction risk: 10% price fall, 18-year mortgage stress highs
Productivity deterioration and per-capita recession despite headline GDP
Gold exploration boom as safe-haven rotation
Energy transition: coal structural decline vs short-term price support
Geopolitical volatility (Iran, Venezuela) amplifying commodity swings

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA fourth rate hike and bond yield spike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration exposure; favour short-dated bonds and floating-rate instruments. Overweight rate-sensitive defensives.
Underweight REITs and home-loan-heavy banks. Monitor NAB.AX, ANZ.AX credit-loss provisions. Diversify into income-generating equities.
Avoid QAN.AX ahead of strike vote outcome. Monitor Qantas revenue and cost-base impact on Q3 earnings.
Screen construction and property-linked equities for liquidity risk. Avoid speculative developers. Monitor ASIC and Icac actions.
Hedge commodity exposure. Maintain gold allocation (GWN.AX, AUC.AX) as inflation hedge.
Favour companies with pricing power and export revenue. Underweight domestic-only consumer names.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners and explorers as safe-haven and inflation hedge
opportunities.rationale: Multiple high-grade discoveries (Gateway, King River 44g/t, Moonlight) plus rate-hike-driven gold price support. Auric's $28M profit confirms sector profitability.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to coal/LNG on short-term price support
opportunities.rationale: Coal boom and oil spike provide near-term revenue uplift for WDS.AX and BHP.AX energy segment, despite long-term transition headwinds.
ASIC investigation declared 'over' removes overhang; Ellison faces no action. Sentiment catalyst for lithium equity.

defensive_moves.rationale: 10% house-price fall forecast, 18-year mortgage stress highs, and developer implosions create credit and occupancy risk.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Qantas ahead of strike vote
defensive_moves.rationale: Ground-crew strike vote introduces operational and revenue uncertainty into Q3 earnings cycle.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash/gold allocation; reduce long-duration bonds
defensive_moves.rationale: Bond yields spiking on rate-hike fears; inflation 'home-grown' suggests RBA won't pivot soon. Gold offers dual hedge.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight Big Four banks on credit-loss risk
defensive_moves.rationale: Mortgage stress at 18-year highs will translate to rising NPLs and provisions within 2–3 quarters, offsetting NIM gains.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months. Fourth RBA rate hike, oil-driven inflation, and housing stress dominate. Gold and energy outperform; banks, REITs, and consumer lag. Volatility elevated on geopolitical headlines (Iran, Venezuela).
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Per-capita recession and 'bad to worse' productivity cap earnings growth. Housing correction may deepen. Gold and resources remain structural beneficiaries. Energy transition reshapes coal equities. Recovery contingent on RBA pivot and housing stabilisation.
